title: Introduce SslContextOption which can be used for "optional" features …

timeline.message:
Introduce SslContextOption which can be used for "optional" features in SslContext implementations

Motivation:

Some of the features we want to support can only be supported by some of the SslContext implementations. We should allow to configure these in a consistent way the same way as we do it with Channel / ChannelOption

Modifications:

- Add SslContextOption and add builder methods that take these
- Add OpenSslContextOption and define two options there which are specific to openssl

Result:

More flexible configuration and implementation of SslContext
timeline.author: Norman Maurer

timeline.body:
You use the varargs to avoid updating many other source call sites?

I'm wondering if there's a reason the Set can't be passed directly.

reply.body: @chrisvest the reason is that I want to ensure we actually can't affect the configured options once build is called. Otherwise it may be possible in the future that some of these options are used in a lazy fashion and a user may call `.option(...)` after `.build()` and so change the already built `SslContext`.
Also I thought not using varargs makes things more explicit.

timeline.body: the constructor we are calling does a `ctxOptions != null` check ... can we just pass `null` here? If not does it make sense to cache this empty array?

reply.body: actually we don't need the constructor anymore... Removed it

timeline.body: nit: use a cached empty array?
IIUC the ALPN is also required, consider clarifying that as well.
